speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned a history of dialogue but no initial response from the patient regarding their symptoms. Can you please describe the breast mass you are experiencing, including how long it has been present and if it is painful? REQUEST TEST: Breast_Clinical_Exam

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Gastroenteritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That diagnosis seems incorrect; gastroenteritis affects the digestive system, not the breast. Please clarify if the rapid growth has occurred over weeks or months, and do you have any history of breast lumps or family history of breast cancer? REQUEST TEST: Mammography

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Fibroadenoma. While the mammogram shows a smooth polylobulated mass, the rapid increase in size warrants a biopsy to rule out malignancy, as typical fibroadenomas usually grow slowly. REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_Left_Breast.
